title: Safety and Responsible Practice — Hazard, Authorization and Handoff Practical
evidenceOutputs: Chemical or input pre-use verification record
criticalErrors: Knowingly continues work through an unresolved electrical, chemical, heat, machinery, fall, or other serious safety hazard instead of stopping or escalating.
Directs or performs a chemical or pesticide use after the scenario shows that crop, site, label, worker-protection, or jurisdictional authorization is unresolved.
Knowingly enters or directs another worker into a restricted or otherwise unsafe area without verifying the applicable reentry or access control.
Falsifies, erases, or backdates a safety, application, exposure, incident, authorization, or corrective-action record to conceal a discrepancy.
